definition: Junyang Lin (Chinese：林俊旸，born 1993) is a Chinese computer scientist and artificial intelligence researcher.
details: Spearheaded the development and open-sourcing of the Qwen language, coding, audio, and vision-language model families. He was the former lead of large language models at Alibaba's Tongyi Lab and one of the youngest P10-level technical experts in Alibaba Cloud's history. Lin was an early pioneer and the principal technical lead behind Qwen (formerly Tongyi Qwen), Alibaba's flagship open-source large language model system.
